body.p: In re Appln. Of: Lotfi B. Othmane et al. Application No.: 17/353,396

In the Notice to File Corrected Application Papers dated July 2, 2021, the Office indicated that the line spacing on pages 8 and 11 of the specification was not 1.5 or double spaced. Therefore, the Office required a substitute specification with proper line spacing provided throughout. Applicants submit herewith a substitute specification to address the line spacing issue. The Notice provides that a marked up version of the specification is not required for this correction, and thus, Applicants have only submitted the clean version of the substitute specification in which the line spacing on pages 8 and 11 is increased to 1.5x spacing. No new matter is presented by this amendment. Applicants respectfully request that the substitute specification submitted herewith replace the specification as originally filed.

The application is considered in good and proper form for examination, and the Examiner is respectfully requested to consider the application on the merits. If, in the opinion of the Examiner, a telephone conference would expedite the prosecution of the subject application, the Examiner is invited to call the undersigned attorney.

p.u: Extension of Time and Fee Deficiency

body.p: Applicants believe no extension of time is required. However, this conditional petition is being made to provide for the possibility that Applicants have inadvertently overlooked the need for a petition and fee for extension of time. If any additional fee is required, or any overpayment is made, in connection with this communication please charge or credit deposit account No. 50- 3505.
